grids.dashboard_mode: High Density Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12, gap-4)

navigation: Policy Mode vs Analyst Mode toggle
instructions_to_main_agent: Build a React application with Tailwind CSS, Lucide React icons, Recharts for data visualization, and Sonner for toasts.

Implement Policy Intelligence Mode (high-level executive briefs, CPI tracking, policy implications) and Analyst Mode (deep raw data exploration, regression backtesting, outlier filtering, simulated daily pipeline ingestion).
Include all 12 navigation sections specified in the problem statement.
Ensure 100% of interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Adhere strictly to the Midnight Aviation Intelligence theme (#08111F bg, #101D2D cards, #1E3145 borders, #35A7FF accent).

Include live interactive features: CSV upload and pipeline trigger, CPI calculator, AI Insights (GPT-5.4 / Gemini simulation), REST API explorer with cURL snippets, and Backtesting against DGCA benchmark.
universal_guidelines: Never use complete transparent backgrounds for overlays or dropdowns.
Always set explicit text color on hover.
Use Generous spacing and sharp cardless or subtle 8px border-radius styling appropriate for RBI/NSO grade dashboards.
NO space grotesk font, NO teal green/blue (#1B93A4).
